The duvet that never needs a cover.

The Teddybed is a duvet with teddy fleece sewn onto the filling, so there is no separate cover to wash or lose. Creators use it as their everyday duvet, not a blanket or throw, and wash it whole in the machine. Zelesta sells it in the Netherlands and Germany, in single and double sizes, in taupe, cream, anthracite and green.

Questions people ask before buying

The questions Google shows for this product, answered from what 185 creators actually said and showed in their stories.

Is the Zelesta Teddybed machine washable and easy to care for?

Yes, Zelesta confirms the duvet is machine washable and hypoallergenic in both NL and DE. Easy care came up in 23 of 220 stories read, with one reviewer saying it washes well and even the smallest allergen sufferer sleeps great in it.

What sizes and colors does the Teddybed come in?

It is sold in single and double sizes, in taupe, cream, anthracite and green. Creators often praised its versatile, practical design fitting many rooms and needs, a theme seen in 53 of 220 stories read, while stylish neutral color options appeared in 39 of 220 stories.

Is the Teddybed warm enough for winter use?

Cozy comfort and warmth was the single biggest theme in the creator content, mentioned in 185 of 220 stories read, describing it as soft, warm and plush. Several posts also called it a winter essential for cold days.

Does the Teddybed replace my normal duvet and duvet cover?

Yes, the teddy fleece top is sewn directly onto the filling, so it replaces both the duvet and the cover. It is not a blanket or a separate cover, so you do not need extra bedding on top of it.

Is it suitable for kids or people with allergies?

The Teddybed is hypoallergenic and machine washable, and kids showed up as a notable audience in the creator stories. One quote specifically mentioned that it washes well and even the smallest allergen sufferer sleeps great with it.

Are there any downsides mentioned by reviewers?

Sentiment was overwhelmingly positive, with 215 of 220 stories read being positive.
